an_internship_journal_may_contain_names_: An internship journal may contain names, internal projects, compensation, feedback or company information. Do not store passwords, API secrets, customer data, medical information or content your workplace prohibits from external tools.
clearing_browser_data_using_another_prof: Clearing browser data, using another profile or resetting the device may make this information unavailable. JSON exports provide a portable backup.
contact_privacy: For a privacy question about this product foundation: {{email}}.
in_local_mode_internships_entries_goals_: In local mode, internships, entries, goals, notes, settings, evaluations and compensation information are stored in the local storage of the browser being used. Practicora does not automatically transfer this data to a server.
supabase_may_send_confirmation_password_: Supabase may send confirmation, password recovery and security emails when these features are enabled. Delivery depends on the Supabase project configuration and, in production, the selected SMTP provider.
the_app_supports_structured_data_export_: The app supports structured data export. Local reset clears the browser workspace after confirmation. Cloud account and data deletion must be connected to production procedures before commercialization.
the_delivered_foundation_does_not_integr: The delivered foundation does not integrate advertising or third-party behavioral tracking. Any future analytics must be documented here and configured according to applicable obligations.
this_policy_describes_the_current_practi: This policy describes the current Practicora foundation. It must be adapted to the final domain, hosting provider and business model before public launch.
when_supabase_variables_are_configured_a: When Supabase variables are configured and a user creates an account, Supabase processes the email address, authentication information and a JSON snapshot of workspace data. The provided table uses Row Level Security policies to limit access to the matching authenticated user.
your_internship_data_should_remain_under: Your internship data should remain under your control.
metadata_description: Understand how Practicora stores data locally and uses Supabase when cloud synchronization is enabled.
